program.name: Seven Shelves
program.subject: Weekly mix
program.blurb: Seven days from seven shelves: kicks, a full-body lift, jumps, core, yoga, a mixed day and back care.
program.about: A week that takes one day from each shelf in its own order. Kickboxing bouts, a full-body strength day, jumps and skips, core and grip, a power yoga flow with Pilates, a mixed upper-body day and a back-care day with a long stretch. The full-body day never sits next to another hard lifting day. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Kickboxing / full-body strength / jumps / core & grip / yoga / mixed / back care
